title: OSHA crane signal person qualifications practice questions
description: Practice questions on who must qualify crane signal persons, the two options, documentation, re-assessment and the requirements (29 CFR 1926.1428).

questions.topic: Who must make sure, and when
questions.question: 1926.1428(a) requires the employer to ensure that each signal person meets the "Qualification Requirements". Where in the rule are those requirements set out?
questions.explanation: Paragraph (a) refers to "the Qualification Requirements (paragraph (c) of this section)", and paragraph (c) is headed "Qualification Requirements. Each signal person must:".

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: Who must make sure, and when
questions.question: A contractor assigns a newly hired laborer to signal a crane on the first morning and plans to have the laborer assessed at the end of the week. How does 1926.1428(a) treat that plan?

options.A: It complies, because the assessment comes within the first 30 days
options.B: It complies, if the crane operator agrees to accept the laborer's signals in the meantime
options.C: It falls short, because the employer must ensure the signal person meets the Qualification Requirements prior to giving any signals
options.D: It complies, if a second signal person stands next to the laborer

questions.explanation: "The employer of the signal person must ensure that each signal person meets the Qualification Requirements (paragraph (c) of this section) prior to giving any signals."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Option (1) and Option (2) in 1926.1428(a) each point to § 1926.1401 for a definition. Which defined terms do they point to?

options.A: Qualified Evaluator (third party) and Qualified Evaluator (not a third party)

questions.explanation: Option (1) says "see Qualified Evaluator (third party), § 1926.1401 for definition", and Option (2) says "see Qualified Evaluator (not a third party), § 1926.1401 for definition".

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under Option (1) in 1926.1428(a)(1), what must the third party qualified evaluator's documentation show?

options.A: The number of hours the signal person has worked near cranes
options.B: That the signal person also holds crane operator certification
options.C: The rated capacity of each crane the signal person will direct
options.D: That the signal person meets the Qualification Requirements

questions.explanation: Under Option (1), "The signal person has documentation from a third party qualified evaluator ... showing that the signal person meets the Qualification Requirements (see paragraph (c) of this section)."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under Option (2) in 1926.1428(a)(2), what must the employer's qualified evaluator provide once it determines that the individual meets the Qualification Requirements?

options.A: A wallet card issued by OSHA
options.C: A report to the crane's manufacturer
options.D: A copy of the crane operator's certification

questions.explanation: The employer's qualified evaluator "assesses the individual and determines that the individual meets the Qualification Requirements (see paragraph (c) of this section) and provides documentation of that determination."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: 1926.1428(a)(2) ends with a sentence that limits who may rely on an assessment. Which assessment does that sentence cover?

options.A: Documentation from a third party qualified evaluator under Option (1)
options.B: A test given by the crane's manufacturer
options.C: An assessment by an employer's qualified evaluator under Option (2)
options.D: An assessment by the crane operator during the lift

questions.explanation: "An assessment by an employer's qualified evaluator under this option is not portable—other employers are not permitted to use it to meet the requirements of this section."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: For what period does 1926.1428(a)(3) require the employer to make the signal person's qualification documentation available at the site?

options.A: While the signal person is employed by the employer
options.B: For three years after the signal person's last lift
options.C: Only until the crane's next annual inspection
options.D: Only on the first day the signal person works at the site

questions.explanation: "The employer must make the documentation for whichever option is used available at the site while the signal person is employed by the employer."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: 1926.1428(a)(3) says the documentation must specify each type of signaling the signal person is qualified for. Which examples of types of signaling does the rule give?
questions.explanation: "The documentation must specify each type of signaling (e.g. hand signals, radio signals, etc.) for which the signal person meets the requirements of paragraph (c) of this section."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: To which option does the documentation duty in 1926.1428(a)(3) apply?

options.B: Whichever option is used, Option (1) or Option (2)
options.D: Neither option when the signal person is a direct employee

questions.explanation: The employer must make "the documentation for whichever option is used" available at the site.

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: When a signal person falls short
questions.question: Under 1926.1428(b), what triggers the employer's duty to stop an individual from continuing to work as a signal person?

options.A: Subsequent actions by the signal person indicate that the individual does not meet the Qualification Requirements
options.B: The signal person has not given signals for 30 days
options.C: The crane is moved to a new site
options.D: A new operator starts work on the crane

questions.explanation: Paragraph (b) applies "If subsequent actions by the signal person indicate that the individual does not meet the Qualification Requirements".

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.topic: When a signal person falls short
questions.question: Under 1926.1428(b), the re-assessment that must follow re-training has to be made in accordance with which paragraph?
questions.explanation: The employer must not allow the individual to continue "until re-training is provided and a re-assessment is made in accordance with paragraph (a) of this section that confirms that the individual meets the Qualification Requirements."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: On a job where a signal person gives only radio signals, what does 1926.1428(c)(1) require the signal person to know and understand?

options.B: The voltage of nearby power lines

questions.explanation: Each signal person must "Know and understand the type of signals used."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: 1926.1428(c)(2) requires each signal person to be competent in what?

options.A: The application of the type of signals used

questions.explanation: Each signal person must "Be competent in the application of the type of signals used."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: 1926.1428(c)(3) lists boom deflection among the crane dynamics a signal person must have a basic understanding of. What does the rule name as the cause of that boom deflection?
questions.explanation: Each signal person must have a basic understanding of equipment operation and limitations, "including the crane dynamics involved in swinging and stopping loads and boom deflection from hoisting loads."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: Under 1926.1428(c)(4), the relevant requirements of which sections must a signal person know and understand?
questions.explanation: Each signal person must "Know and understand the relevant requirements of §§ 1926.1419 through 1926.1422 and 1926.1428."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)

questions.question: 1926.1428(c)(5) requires a signal person to pass an oral or written test and a practical test. What must those tests show?

options.A: That the signal person meets the operator requirements of § 1926.1427
options.B: That the signal person can inspect the crane's rigging
options.C: That he/she meets the requirements in paragraphs (c)(1) through (4)
options.D: That the crane's rated capacity is not exceeded

questions.explanation: Each signal person must "Demonstrate that he/she meets the requirements in paragraphs (c)(1) through (4) of this section through an oral or written test, and through a practical test."

source.title: eCFR: 29 CFR 1926.1428, Signal person qualifications (as of Nov 4, 2026)
